purpose: Temporary migration ceiling. Existing third-party runtime dependencies may only decrease; no new runtime dependency may be introduced.
rule: package.json dependencies must be a subset of this list until the list reaches empty. New entries are forbidden. Source-import ceilings are one-way migration guards: counts/files may only decrease.

@react-three/fiber.rule: R3F source imports are zero after first-party viewport-host parity and may not return. The package remains temporarily only because the still-gated Drei package depends on the R3F ecosystem.

@react-three/drei.rule: Drei source imports are already zero and may not return.

zustand.rule: Direct Zustand source imports are already zero and may not return.

react.rule: React source imports are zero after the first-party DOM, viewport and startup migrations and may not return.

react-dom.rule: ReactDOM source imports are zero after the project-owned root/startup switch and may not return.
